name: 临床矿物营养胶囊套图款
description: 医研风矿物营养胶囊套图：白底主图、空白规格表、纯净图标与场景收口

styleLock.direction: clinical research-grade supplement commerce, clean pharma-minimal
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool light grey #EEF2F7 for information panels, deep clinical blue #1D4E9E for claim and icon fields, one consistent rounded-corner card language
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, skimming side light only for texture macro, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, 5600K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte neutral board #E4E8EE and seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, no wood grain, no marble veining
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, information carried by blank label bars and empty callout lines only, no rendered copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside outlined circles, stroke in #FFFFFF or #1D4E9E, flat, no gradients, no third-party seal artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright bottle scale across the set, caps always closed, capsules shown as plain opaque off-white #F4F1EC cylinders, label faces left intentionally blank
noDrift: no numeric dosage, strength or size values
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical research-grade supplement visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, deep clinical blue #1D4E9E, cool light grey #EEF2F7 and neutral board grey #E4E8EE with off-white capsule tone #F4F1EC; cool 5600K high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with information carried only by blank label bars; thin single-weight line icons inside outlined circles, no seal artwork; stable upright product scale with intentionally blank label faces; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no certification badges, no numeric values.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼建立医研可信度并赢得点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle upright with a slight 3/4 turn, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, clean full-bleed white field
shots.promptTemplate: Clinical packshot of {product} standing upright on a seamless flat white #FFFFFF field, straight-on eye-level camera with a slight 3/4 turn so the blank side panel just reads, full silhouette visible and not cropped. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a front-left softbox with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the bottle, no specular blowout, 5600K. Label faces are intentionally blank planes with no wordmark, no seal, no barcode and no numbers. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame and is horizontally centered. Negative: no brand wordmark, no certification marks, no dosage or strength figures, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating bottle, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 让买家代入自律健康的生活方式，承接第一利益点
shots.camera: side profile at eye-level, mid-shot, model in the left two thirds, panel on the right
shots.lighting: soft natural morning light from behind-left, 5600K, gentle rim on shoulders, panel lit flat and even
shots.background: blurred outdoor greenery on the left meeting a deep clinical blue #1D4E9E vertical panel on the right
shots.props: a matte reusable water bottle on the stone step, never covering {product}
shots.whitespace: generous clean space on the right 40% for the information panel
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene with an information panel: a generic adult in athletic wear stretching on a concrete step in soft morning light, face turned away and not identifiable, photographed in clean side profile at eye-level as a mid-shot. {product} sits small and upright on the step beside a matte water bottle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft natural backlight from the left at 5600K with a gentle rim on the shoulders, matched by flat even light on the right-hand panel. The left two thirds are blurred outdoor greenery; the right third is a deep clinical blue #1D4E9E vertical panel holding a rounded off-white #FFFFFF card with one blank title bar and three outlined thin-line icons each followed by an empty label line. The product and model together occupy 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no recognizable face, no rendered words or letters, no efficacy icons that look like medical seals, no more than three callout lines, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 用规范的信息版面消除成分透明度疑虑
shots.camera: straight-on front view, flat graphic plane, panel centred
shots.lighting: even flat high-key light, no shadow falloff, no hotspot on the card
shots.background: cool light grey #EEF2F7 with a rounded white #FFFFFF panel card
shots.props: one small outlined circle marker at the card foot
shots.whitespace: even panel margins, no extra copy space outside the card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic screen shot straight-on at eye-level: a rounded off-white #FFFFFF panel card centred on a cool light grey #EEF2F7 field, holding a blank supplement-facts frame with an empty header bar, empty rule lines and fully empty table cells, plus one empty disclaimer box outline and a single row of small outlined circle markers along the foot. {product} appears small at the card corner in a clean front view. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat high-key studio light with no shadow falloff, 5600K, thin line work in deep clinical blue #1D4E9E. The panel and product together occupy 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no numeric values, no percentages, no ingredient names, no units, no rendered text of any kind, no certification logos, no seals, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body copy, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 以真实尺度锚点交代颗粒大小与质地，消除吞咽顾虑
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down into an open palm
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing the capsule seam, soft falloff, shallow depth of field
shots.background: neutral matte board #E4E8EE with a soft-focus striped shirt behind
shots.props: one open hand, person cropped at the chest with no face in frame
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} as a single plain opaque off-white #F4F1EC capsule resting in an open palm, tight zoom on the capsule body and seam, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field with only the capsule edge sharp. The person is cropped at the chest so no face can be seen. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Skimming side light from the right at 5600K revealing the smooth shell texture, soft falloff into a neutral matte board background #E4E8EE. One empty thin dimension bracket line floats above the capsule with no figure on it. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no measurement numbers or units, no dimension label text, no deformed or extra fingers, no face, no invented swallowability claim, no blurry subject, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 以纯净配方矩阵降低选择风险
shots.camera: straight-on front view, symmetrical three-by-three grid, grid fills the frame
shots.lighting: flat even studio light, no shadows, uniform field
shots.background: deep clinical blue #1D4E9E with a subtle soft vignette
shots.props: nine outlined circles with generic slash marks
shots.whitespace: generous even gutters between grid cells, no copy space needed
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen shot straight-on at eye-level: a symmetrical three-by-three grid of thin single-weight line icons in #FFFFFF inside outlined circles on a deep clinical blue #1D4E9E field, each icon a generic crossed-out everyday object with a slash mark, each circle followed by one short empty label bar. {product} appears once, small and upright, anchored at the lower grid corner. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat even 5600K studio light with no cast shadows and a very subtle vignette. The grid and product together occupy 50-60% of the frame with generous even gutters. Negative: no readable words, no certification marks or third-party seals, no allergen percentages, no medical cross symbols, no gradient icons, no rendered text, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 在同系列中帮助买家选到对的款，提升客单
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, flat lay of the matrix
shots.lighting: even high-key flat light, no directional shadow, identical light on every column
shots.background: seamless white #FFFFFF lower field with a deep clinical blue #1D4E9E header band
shots.props: four additional unbranded blank bottles as siblings, one filled radio dot
shots.whitespace: even column and row spacing, empty label bars along the left rail
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant selection matrix laid out as a flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: a deep clinical blue #1D4E9E header band carrying one blank title bar, then a row of five upright blank bottles with identical silhouettes and unbranded label faces, above a white #FFFFFF grid of thin rules holding empty label bars down the left rail and rows of small outlined radio circles with exactly one filled in #1D4E9E. {product} is the first bottle in the row. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat 5600K lighting with no directional shadow and identical light on every column. The whole matrix occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous breathing room. Negative: no product names, no strengths, no dosage counts, no rendered text, no price tags, no brand wordmarks, no inconsistent lighting between columns, no duplicated bottles, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 以情感化生活方式画面完成收口记忆点
shots.camera: photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, candid documentary framing
shots.lighting: warm late-afternoon sun filtering through trunks from behind-right, cool #EEF2F7 band held flat, 4300K
shots.background: autumn forest path with a soft cool light grey #EEF2F7 band across the lower edge
shots.props: a dog seen from behind, a canvas backpack, one rounded blank chip in the lower corner
shots.whitespace: clean negative space in the upper left 35% for a blank headline bar
shots.promptTemplate: Candid lifestyle close, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward with a documentary feel: a generic adult walking away on an autumn forest path with a dog seen from behind, faces turned away and never identifiable, framed off-centre with natural imperfection. {product} sits in the lower third of the frame on a soft cool light grey #EEF2F7 band beside one rounded blank chip and one blank headline bar in the upper left. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm late-afternoon sun filtering through the trunks from behind-right at 4300K, cool shadow fill, long soft shadows that agree with the direction of light. The scene and product together occupy 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no recognizable face, no brand wordmark or logo, no slogan text, no rendered letters, no discount badges, no invented offers, no star ratings, no contradictory shadow directions, no over-smoothed skin, no watermark, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底瓶身略侧 3/4 主图，可见正面与侧栏信息版；002 深蓝渐变底上的白色营养成分版面＋底部一排线描无添加图标；003 左侧户外拉伸人物侧影＋右侧深蓝信息栏三条利益点；004 掌心单粒胶囊特写带尺寸标注线与底部服用建议色条；005 深蓝底 3x3 线描划除图标矩阵；006 顶部同系列五瓶排布＋下方圆点勾选矩阵；007 秋日林道遛狗人物场景。品类判定依据：图为口服硬胶囊瓶装膳食补充剂，非食品零食亦非外用护肤品，原平台类目常挂食品或美容，此处按实物改判为医药保健／营养补充。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、瓶身与版面内全部原句文案、营养成分表数值与每日剂量与颗粒尺寸数字、第三方认证与无转基因及素食标识图形、高吸收与器官功效类断言、模特可辨识面容与身份、原平台店铺字样与角标；图内文案一律改为空白条与空表格单元，产品以 {product} 占位。
